label: კანონი
about: One provision of Georgian law (an article of the Constitution or a code, from matsne.gov.ge through Ordo) explained neutrally: what it says and whom it concerns. Law rules: claims, plus the article number on screen, the act named, quotes verbatim from the article and no advice. A person watches it before it goes out; the end card links to the article on matsne.gov.ge.
